headline: Petition by Zayo-Fiberco to install fiber optic facilities at Liberty Street and Heywood Street.
summary: Zayo-Fiberco asks to install and maintain fiber optic telecommunication facilities in the public way. The work includes manhole and vault construction, as shown on the Proposed Conduit Installation plan for 396 Liberty St (5 Nursery St) in Springfield, MA.
items: Zayo-Fiberco petition to install and maintain fiber optic telecommunication facilities in the public way, including wires, cables, devices, equipment, and manhole and vault construction (Zayo-Fiberco - Liberty St.)
location: At the corner of Liberty Street and Heywood Street
plain_text:
Board of Public Works                                          1                                       Printed 4/22/2025 
 
 
                         BOARD OF PUBLIC WORKS       
  
                                Hearings Meeting Agenda 
   
  
I hereby notify you that the following items of business have been filed with this office and can 
be acted upon at the meeting of the Board of Public Works Wednesday, October 28, 2026 at 
3:30 PM.  
  
City Clerk  
 
Location 
At the corner of Liberty Street and Heywood Street 
 
Petitions 
Zayo-Fiberco, to install and maintain fiber optic telecommunication facilities in public way, with 
all necessary wires, cables, devices, equipment, and other items relating thereto, and likewise the 
manhole and vault construction connected with said fiber optic facilities, as indicated by said 
plan marked “Proposed Conduit Installation at 396 Liberty St (5 Nursery St) in Springfield, 
MA” 
 1. Zayo-Fiberco -Liberty St.
